activity.notes: A 14 March 1744 archival document cited by Ximena Urbina explicitly calls Martín Olleta 'gobernadorcillo de dicha nación chonos' and places him at Cailín; a 27 March record calls him governor of the indicated indigenous population, including people living on more remote islands. ATLAS uses the directly attested 14 March 1744 point rather than fabricating a multi-year chieftainship. His earlier 1742 rescue of HMS Wager survivors is historical context, not used as an accession date.

sources.title: Ximena Urbina Carrasco, Interacciones entre españoles de Chiloé y Chonos en los siglos XVII y XVIII
sources.citation_text: The peer-reviewed study quotes 1744 archival records describing Martín Olleta as gobernadorcillo of the Chono and as governor of indigenous groups centered on Cailín and more remote islands.
